item.title: Whiskers 0.8.48
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.48

### Recording Reliability

  • Improved recording startup, cancellation, and hands-free controls so hotkey dictation responds more consistently
  • Improved live cloud dictation finalization so longer recordings complete more reliably after speech ends

    • ### Bulk Transcription

  • Improved bulk transcription cancellation so deleting an active video job stops processing sooner and continues with the remaining queue
  • Improved waveform handling for large transcript histories to keep the app responsive over time

    • ### Privacy & Security

  • Improved support logs by redacting sensitive details and sending a license fingerprint instead of the license key
  • Strengthened cloud request protections for custom providers and built-in transcription services
  • Fixed Gemini requests so API keys are no longer placed in the request URL

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed toast notifications so short messages keep a usable minimum size
  • Improved Dictionary row actions so edit and delete controls reveal cleanly on hover or keyboard focus
